svg.title: One side, two, then four
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Lesson 3-4 build-up on a 3 by 3 taped grid, the robot starting parked on the bottom-left corner facing away from you. First test_one_side(): it arrives at two intersections up the left side and turns right on the top-left corner. Then test_square() with range(2): two sides, ending on the top-right corner facing down the right side. Then range(4): all four sides, ending back on the start corner facing the way it began. Beside it, the loop for each run, with the line running highlighted.
svg.text: Each pass of the loop draws one side and
turns the corner, so changing the number
in range() changes how much of the

g.text: on the corner, facing the next side
an L, facing the third side
back on the start corner, facing away
